description: Aménagements cyclables is a dataset listed in Open Data Hauts-de-Seine, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Rueil-Malmaison. Les aménagements cyclables Les aménagements cyclables permettent une circulation douce dans Rueil-Malmaison La ville soucieuse d’améliorer son cadre de vie, poursuit le développement des mobilités douces. Des pistes cyclables, des voies vertes et des places de stationnements sécurisées pour les vélos sont aménagées sur l’ensemble du territoire. Coverage: Hauts-de-Seine. The portal files it under Transport / Mobilité. Its keywords are vélos, véloroutes, pistes cyclables. The portal shows 93 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-08-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-hauts-de-seine-fr-portal.
